g.text: GARTH / ART DIRECTION, NOT ICON VARIATIONS
Change the medium. Then refine the form.
Five deliberately different treatments. All use one ink color and transparent negative space.
1 / 8-bit pixel art
A game-sprite character, built from square pixels.
STYLE STUDY · NOT A FINAL APP ICON
2 / Scratchy charcoal
Rough edges, scraped highlights, restless marks.
STYLE STUDY · NOT A FINAL APP ICON
3 / Copperplate engraving
Fine hair strands and crosshatched portrait detail.
STYLE STUDY · NOT A FINAL APP ICON
4 / Brush & ink
Broad, tapered strokes and an expressive gesture.
STYLE STUDY · NOT A FINAL APP ICON
5 / Art Nouveau
Ornamental curves, botanical details, flowing hair.
STYLE STUDY · NOT A FINAL APP ICON
Pick the visual language first. Face shape, hair, glasses, and small-size readability come next.
Original vector studies. No changes to the app’s current icon.
